usage.guide: Send a POST to https://x402-deployer.x402-deployer.workers.dev/ipfs-fetch with JSON body {"cid":"<IPFS CID>"} and pay the $0.005 USDC x402 quote on Base. The response is JSON: the file bytes are in body.content as a base64 string (decode it), with body.content_type giving the real MIME type and body.size_bytes the length. body.gateway_used shows which public gateway served it (e.g. https://ipfs.io). Synchronous — no polling, no auth needed.
